author: Helen Bird
time_standard: UTC for observations; Asia/Shanghai for editorial dates
publication_scope: Reviewed aggregate observations and method notes only. Private raw Search Console/Bing responses, screenshots, account identifiers, private workflow links and credentials are excluded.

sitemap.observation_note: The successful batch read confirmed the previously imported feed. A later quota stop prevented a new feed read; this does not negate the earlier observation.

indexnow.publication_followup: This genuine new learning record and its navigation changes may be notified only after deployment and validation. No receipt is claimed in this edition.

monitoring.default_interval_status: The observed joint run used five seconds. A proposed ten-second default is not represented as deployed in this snapshot.
monitoring.history: Original baselines and failed/skipped attempts are retained privately.

limitations: Query success is not an index-membership verdict.
Live HTTP access and a declared crawler user agent do not prove a real crawler visited.
No experiment in this lesson measured ChatGPT/Grok answers or recommendation lift.
The ten-second and five-second runs occurred at different times; interval alone cannot explain their different results.
This publication adds two editorial pages to the inventory. Those new pages are outside the earlier ten- and seventy-URL snapshots.

followups.observation: The Google Search Console Sitemaps screen reported "Could not read this sitemap", with a displayed last-read date of November 4 and zero discovered pages.
followups.verified: This is an independently recorded owner-console observation, separate from the API isPending=true response. No corrective resubmission had been made at this observation.
followups.limit: The screen did not expose a specific HTTP or XML error. A successful API submission and a browser HTTP 200 do not establish a successful Google fetch.

followups.observation: One corrective Google Sitemap submission was accepted in the owner console after the genuine Lab #05 publication changed the verified Sitemap from 10 to 12 canonical URLs.
followups.verified: The success confirmation followed the submission started at 12:56:01 UTC. This was a separate corrective UI action, not a second initial API PUT or a recurring duplicate submission.
followups.limit: Acceptance does not establish that Google downloaded, processed or indexed the new pages. The earlier could-not-read observation remains in the record.

followups.observation: The expanded Google indexed-version snapshot covered 12 important canonical URLs.
followups.verified: 5 URLs were INDEXED and 7 were NOT_INDEXED. The two new editorial pages are part of this later twelve-URL scope, not the earlier ten-URL baseline.
followups.limit: These are official Google indexed-version observations at this time, not live tests, Bing outcomes or evidence of AI recommendations.

followups.observation: The Google Sitemap API was read after the corrective UI submission.
followups.verified: isPending remained true, lastDownloaded was absent, and the returned error and warning counts were zero.
followups.limit: A successful submission is not confirmed processing. No new download time is inferred from the missing field.

followups.observation: The later combined monitor queried all 72 current canonical content URLs in Bing with ten-second spacing.
followups.verified: 72/72 URL queries succeeded; site access and the Sitemap read also succeeded. The feed remained registered with processing status Success.
followups.limit: All 72 Bing index-membership states remain UNKNOWN. This later success does not erase the earlier five-second throttled run or prove that spacing alone caused recovery.

followups.observation: OpenAI search crawl-eligibility checks expanded to the 72 current canonical content URLs.
followups.verified: 72 configuration-allowed results and 72 successful declared-user-agent simulated fetches were recorded.
followups.limit: Real OAI-SearchBot access and OpenAI index membership remain UNKNOWN; simulated access is not a verified crawler visit.

followups.observation: The full combined monitoring workflow completed successfully and made one real IndexNow notification for 11 genuinely new or updated URLs.
followups.verified: The response was HTTP 202 / KEY_VALIDATION_PENDING. The notification, expanded snapshots and history were saved; no ChatGPT/Grok answer experiment was run.
followups.limit: HTTP 202 means key validation remains pending. Receipt acceptance is not crawling, indexing or AI recommendation evidence; unchanged URLs are not repeatedly submitted merely to obtain another status.

followups.observation: Between 2026-11-06T13:19:02.659Z and 2026-11-06T13:33:18.073Z, an owner-authorized assistant used the official Google Search Console interface to request indexing for seven pages.
followups.verified: A fresh indexed-version inspection before each request showed NOT_INDEXED. All seven requests received the interface acknowledgement that the URL had been accepted into the priority crawl queue.
followups.limit: Accepted indexing requests are not evidence that the pages were indexed. The 13:03 UTC snapshot of 5 INDEXED and 7 NOT_INDEXED predates these requests and is not backfilled; this follow-up claims no new post-request indexing result.
